note: One home per fact — the rule is .claude/rules/specs.md. A phrase listed under "owned" may be stated in its owner and nowhere else; every other document links to the owner. Enforced by `pnpm lint:docs` (check-docs.mjs), a step of the CI static job. Add an entry when a fact starts appearing in a second file, and pick the owner from the layer that would have to change if the fact changed. "forbidden" holds the words that may not appear in any tracked file, prose and code alike; this file is the only place they are written. Two paths are outside that scan and are exceptions on purpose: generated output, which is rewritten from its source rather than edited, and pnpm-lock.yaml, whose integrity hashes are not prose.

owned.note: why the digit count is not the ISO exponent
the budget formulas; a second copy is how two screens start disagreeing
why apps/api reports two coverage directories

owned.phrase: reaching every budget the caller owns
owned.note: which operations the budget filter covers, and which take their budget from the payload
one active budget per user, and the preview feature the index costs
what the raw repository refuses inside a mutation and outside one
which client a mutation's work may use, and what the other one refuses

owned.phrase: a result that describes a write it never made
owned.note: why a repeat carrying a different request is refused rather than replayed

owned.phrase: changed inside a mutation like anything else
owned.note: what an exempt model may still do; it moved once already

banned.why: an em dash is the loudest AI tell; end the sentence or use a comma (communication.md)

banned.pattern: \b(in order to|due to the fact that|it is important to note that)\b

banned.why: a war story, not an instruction — specs.md forbids it; the decision belongs to its Notion ticket
state the rule, not the measurement — specs.md
a reproduction transcript goes stale; state what must hold instead — specs.md
a dated observation is false on the next release — specs.md

forbidden.why: a competitor's name and trademark. This project is described by what it does, not by which product it resembles (communication.md)
